text:
Eskom built two giant coal power stations, Medupi and Kusile, each about 4,800 MW. Kusile was budgeted at about R80 billion. It cost more than R160 billion and finished more than 11 years late: its last unit only started running in September 2025. Together the two went more than R300 billion over budget, and Eskom borrowed the money. Borrowed money has to be paid back, with interest.

Full guide: "How Eskom Went Broke, and What It Costs You Every Month (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
